import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long flow, capacity;
        long cost;
        public Edge(int to, int rev, long flow, long capacity, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int total_nodes;
        long[] dist, potential, flow_curr;
        int[] prev_edge, prev_node;
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        static final long MAX_FLOW = (long)1e9;

        public FlowNetwork(int n) {
            total_nodes = n;
            dist = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            flow_curr = new long[n];
            prev_edge = new int[n];
            prev_node = new int[n];
            pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        public void add_edge(int s, int t, long cap, long cst) {
            adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, adj.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
            adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, adj.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
        }

        public long[] maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total_flow = 0;
            long total_cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, MAX_FLOW);
                Arrays.fill(flow_curr, 0);
                Arrays.fill(prev_edge, -1);
                Arrays.fill(prev_node, -1);
                dist[s] = 0;
                flow_curr[s] = MAX_FLOW;
                pq.clear();
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] node = pq.poll();
                    long d = node[0];
                    int u = (int) node[1];
                    if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.capacity <= e.flow) continue;
                        long new_d = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                        if (dist[v] > new_d) {
                            dist[v] = new_d;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{new_d, v});
                            prev_node[v] = u;
                            prev_edge[v] = i;
                            flow_curr[v] = Math.min(flow_curr[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == MAX_FLOW) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                long delta = Math.min(flow_curr[t], MAX_FLOW - total_flow);
                total_flow += delta;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prev_node[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(prev_node[v]).get(prev_edge[v]);
                    e.flow += delta;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= delta;
                    total_cost += delta * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new long[]{total_flow, total_cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 500;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int N = n * T;
        FlowNetwork fn = new FlowNetwork(N + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                fn.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, FlowNetwork.MAX_FLOW, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            fn.add_edge(i, N + 1, FlowNetwork.MAX_FLOW, 0);
        }

        int[] xArr = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            xArr[i] = x;
            fn.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt(); x--;
            int y = sc.nextInt(); y--;
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                int cur = 1;
                for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                    fn.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, (long)cur * d + c);
                    fn.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, (long)cur * d + c);
                    cur += 2;
                }
            }
        }

        long[] res = fn.maxFlow(N, N + 1);
        long totalFlow = res[0];
        long totalCost = res[1];

        if (totalFlow != k) {
            System.out.println("0");
        } else {
            System.out.println(totalCost);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
